critical.issue: Returns 500 (CheckoutError: 'No such checkout.session') when Stripe-side session is not yet visible or invalid. Endpoint should catch CheckoutError and return a structured 4xx (e.g. 404/410) so the frontend /checkout/success polling can render a friendly state instead of breaking. Real users polling immediately after a fresh checkout will hit this race window.

ui_bugs.issue: MISSING IMPORT for GoogleSignIn — file used <GoogleSignIn /> without importing it, causing the entire /login route to crash with a React error boundary fallback. Fixed by adding 'import GoogleSignIn from "@/components/auth/GoogleSignIn"' (Signup.jsx already had it).

rca_of_the_issue:
Two root causes found this iteration:
1) Login.jsx — developer added <GoogleSignIn /> JSX usage but forgot the corresponding import statement, causing 'GoogleSignIn is not defined' ReferenceError that the error boundary swallowed, blanking the whole /login page. Verified by comparing to Signup.jsx which had the import. Applied minimal fix (1-line import) and re-verified Google button renders and login still works. Reproduction: navigate to /login on a fresh deploy — blank black page.
2) /api/payments/status — the StripeCheckout.get_checkout_status() raises CheckoutError when the upstream Stripe API returns 'No such checkout.session' (test-mode key + session id not yet propagated, or session expired). The handler does not catch this, so FastAPI returns a generic 500. Mitigation: wrap the call in try/except CheckoutError and either return the locally-cached pending tx, or raise HTTPException(status_code=404). Reproduction: POST /api/payments/checkout, then within seconds GET /api/payments/status/{session_id} with a Stripe key that doesn't recognize the session.
